research_question: Do RAN deadline misses arise from stop acknowledgement while GPU-client teardown is unfinished, from the fully exited client residual state, or from retaining an initialized idle client?

decision_at_stake.ack_only_excess: If stop-ack-only has significantly more misses than fully-exited in paired rounds (one-sided exact sign p<0.05), classify incomplete client retirement as the phase-linked hazard and require an actual process-exit barrier before a live RAN epoch.
decision_at_stake.fully_exited_excess: If fully-exited still misses more often than idle, classify a residual teardown-state hazard and next distinguish CUDA reset from MPS detach.
decision_at_stake.idle_excess_or_all_zero: If idle also misses or all conditions have zero misses, do not claim a unique retirement phase; report the observed boundary and stop without seed extension.

if_both_outcomes_lead_to_same_action: Cancel the experiment if the result would not choose among retirement, persistent-context, and nonreproduction explanations.
single_question_rule: Only the GPU-client lifecycle phase is varied; no N1 load scaling or AI throughput experiment is included.
strongest_realistic_opponent: The same initialized cap20 MPS NeuralRx client under three lifecycle boundaries: kept alive but idle, stop RPC acknowledged without waiting for process exit, and actual process exit confirmed before first RAN release.

execution.operational_requalification: 200 conventional-only P60/D35 releases with zero misses
execution.order: odd rounds: mps_idle, mps_ack_only, mps_retired; even rounds: reverse

worker.idle_condition: quiesce RPC acknowledgement before first release; process and CUDA context remain alive until stop RPC after final release
worker.retired_condition: stop RPC acknowledgement, then launcher waits for actual worker process exit before allowing the first timed RAN release
worker.ack_only_condition: stop RPC acknowledgement before first release; no process-exit barrier; launcher records process-exit confirmation separately, which may occur before or after first release

measurement_sources.lifecycle: ran JSON:quiesce_response, stop_response, pre_epoch_stop_ack_ns, gpu_client_live_during_epoch, endpoint_retired_at_release, lifecycle_handshake.worker_state/confirmed_ns, first_release_ns; runner waits for actual process exit before writing retired-condition start handshake
measurement_sources.ordering: ran JSON:host, slurm_job_id, seed, iterations, period_ms, deadline_ms

evidence_grade: A only for a clean significant paired ack-only versus fully-exited contrast; otherwise B diagnostic. Idle versus fully-exited is secondary. This localizes a lifecycle boundary but does not identify a single CUDA or MPS internal operation.
interpretation_limits: The paired unit is the seed/condition triplet, not individual RAN releases. A launcher exit-confirmation timestamp after the first release is only an upper bound on actual process exit and cannot by itself prove overlap; the experimental intervention is whether the controller waits for actual exit before admitting the first RAN release. Universal hard isolation and top-conference novelty remain unproven.
